lookalikes.story: Italy is the boot everyone knows, kicking the island of Sicily like a ball.
Chile runs 4,300 km north to south but averages only 177 km across. It borders one ocean and one mountain range, and that is what stretched it.
Croatia wraps around Bosnia, which is what bends it. Some people say a croissant instead.
Sri Lanka is often called the teardrop of India, hanging just below it.
Many people see a scruffy dog facing left, with Cape York as an ear.
The French call their own country l'Hexagone, because it has roughly six sides.
Portugal is one of the tidiest shapes on the map, a tall rectangle down the side of Spain.
Norway curls round Sweden with a long thin handle and a wider bowl at the north.
India narrows to a point at the bottom, which is why it reads as a diamond or an arrowhead.
The Peloponnese in the south reaches into the sea with four finger-like points.
Russia is the biggest country there is, and many people see a bison or bear facing right.
Cambodia is close to a square with a rounded top, which is why people see a slice.
